configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Uses Boost found on the system; if none is found the header-only Boost distribution is downloaded automatically. Qt is taken from the system.

configurePresets.name: vcpkg
configurePresets.displayName: vcpkg (fetch Boost via the vcpkg manifest)
configurePresets.description: Installs the Boost dependencies listed in vcpkg.json through vcpkg. Requires the VCPKG_ROOT environment variable to point at a vcpkg checkout. Qt is taken from the system.
